title: Cursor Plugin Marketplace
description: Schema for .cursor-plugin/marketplace.json — defines a marketplace that indexes one or more Cursor plugins.

plugins.description: List of plugins available in the marketplace.

name.description: Plugin identifier matching the plugin's name in its plugin.json.

source.description: Path to the plugin directory (relative to the marketplace root) or a remote URL.

minClientVersions.description: Minimum client versions required to install the plugin, keyed by client identifier.

cursor.description: Minimum Cursor version required to install the plugin (e.g. "3.13.0"), or "never" to hide it from Cursor entirely.

grokbot.description: Minimum Grok Bot version required to install the plugin (e.g. "0.49.0"), or "never" to hide it from Grok Bot entirely.

sand.description: Deprecated client id for Grok Bot. Same meaning as grokbot.

additionalProperties.description: Minimum version required for another client identifier, or "never" to hide the plugin from that client.

clientVersionRequirement.description: A minimum semantic version, or the literal "never" when that client must not list or install the plugin.

semver.description: Strict semantic version "X.Y.Z" with an optional prerelease suffix.
